name: cyber-gallery-mai
description: Reproducible asset tooling for Cyber Gallery for Mai Theme.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: terser assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai.min.js && terser assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-packing.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-packing.min.js && terser assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-comparison.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-comparison.min.js && terser assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-lightbox.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-lightbox.min.js && terser assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-editor.js --compress --mangle --output assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-editor.min.js
scripts.check: npm run lint:js && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit && node scripts/check-version.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check:syntax: node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai.min.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-packing.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-packing.min.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-comparison.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-comparison.min.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-lightbox.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-lightbox.min.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-editor.js && node --check assets/js/cyber-gallery-mai-editor.min.js
